text:
diego: Observed another authz regression during deploy window — token introspect flaked and audit sidecar OOMed on a few pods. This mirrors the token-validation postmortem pattern. Starting a thread to capture owners, short mitigations, and a drill schedule.

olivia: Ugh. Can you paste logs/snippets?

diego: Pasting a simplified log sample: `2024-06-14T03:21:10Z service-x introspect ERROR status=502 body=read timeout` and `audit-sidecar kubelet: OOMKilled`. Looks like sidecar memory limits too low + an intermittent network spike to introspection endpoint.

jamie: I'll take sidecar memory tuning + add OOM alert. Owner @jamie 12h to PR.

priyanka: I'll own token-introspect circuit-breaker and retry logic in the rotator. Plan: add exponential backoff and a fail-open mode so rotator doesn't mass-revoke on transient errors. ETA EOD tomorrow.

marie: I'll add a short-term mitigation: pin the rollout and revert any service that increases concurrency until rotator is fixed. Also can we run an emergency rotate for tokens that report TTL > 120 days?

diego: Yes please. Marie, coordinate with @priyanka for a dry-run first.

priyanka: Dry-run command ready: 
```
./rotator --dry-run --since-days=120 --introspect-endpoint=https://introspect.internal/api
```
Will post PR after unit tests pass.

jamie: Sidecar limit PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/sidecar-limits/pull/9 14h review requested from @olivia and @marie. Added prometheus rule: `kube_pod_ooms_total > 0` alert with 5m window.

olivia: I'll review. Also volunteer to own the runbook for emergency manual rotation if the rotator misfires. Will add contact list + rollback steps. ETA tomorrow morning.

sec-bot: security: Created SEC-1108 "Token health & audit sidecar stability". Linked incident-712 and noted recurrence pattern. Priority: P1 due to customer-facing errors.

deploy-bot: deploy: Canary blocked for service-x due to failing healthcheck (introspect 502) at 2024-06-14T03:28Z.

marie: Also proposing a short drill: runbook drill next Tue 10am PT. We simulate a failed introspect and execute manual rotation to validate ops. Owner @marie to run drill.

priyanka: Adding telemetry events `token.introspect.fail` and `audit.sidecar.oom` so we can track recurrence rate. Will add dashboard with weekly trend.

diego: Good. Quick checklist: (1) jamie: sidecar oom alert + PR, (2) priyanka: rotator CB + dry-run, (3) olivia: manual runbook, (4) marie: drill schedule, (5) sam (ops): add runbook to oncall rota. Please post blockers.

olivia: One blocker: need confirmation on safe window to rotate (avoid peak traffic). @priyanka can you add `--max-parallel=5` to rotator so we can throttle?

priyanka: Yep will add `--max-parallel` and default to 3 for now.

jamie: PR merged for alert rules. Will monitor tonight and escalate if OOMs appear.

marie: Drill scheduled and calendar invites sent. If you can't attend, please add pre-read notes in the runbook.

diego: Thanks team. I'll update the postmortem follow-up checklist and we will reconvene after the drill for retrospective. :thumbsup:
